## JAMBO SAYS THE CONTRACT IN FRONT — PASS 4 (18 Oct 2026, lane B1)

After main moved on (LAND ON IT, the new bar, the Counter named Home), the checker compared rounds 13, 7 and 12 with the drawings again and listed 21 differences. This pass merged main, built each difference and kept the held-contract guard inside main's own pinned code (`!heldId` before `state.view`).

What was built and why:
- Round 13: the count line says the agreements only, because an amendment rides on its agreement's paper. The next papers load on scroll near the foot, as drawn. The browser check found that the wall's own box is the scroller on the desk, and the scroll listener only listened to boxes *around* the wall, so scroll-to-load never fired in real use. It now hears the wall's own box (f740 6a pins it). Jambo's tab carries Home's Needs-you number everywhere a contract is held and on the wall at rest. The bell still counts a different list, and that is asked of the owner.
- Round 7: the glance says what the page owes first: the private stream's wall, the details still to fill and a missing signer. "Nothing is late" is said only where it is true. The details row first read "1 detail to fill: effective." (the table's label). Record boxes now have sentence words ("the start date", "base pay"). An amendment's purpose is said only in its maker's own note (`relationNote`), never guessed. Details reads the value in short figures, as drawn ("SEK 7.1 M as amended / 6.4 M signed"), because full figures were cut in the card; contract-page-verify 5 was re-pointed for this. The family's acts left Related agreements for the page's ⋯, so the rows match the drawing (ref · what · signed · Bring it up).
- Round 12: one send writes up to three trail lines (round archived, "Round N closed by …", "Turn handed to …"). They are now one entry in our lane, and their hand-back is theirs. This is a change to the shared reading `roomHistoryEvents`, so the phone tells a send once too, while still printing the trail's own words. Filters offer only what the trail holds (the owner's 10 Oct rule). Clear greys at rest. The middle line is one quiet pill with no initials. The fingerprint moved to the time's hover. The menu's lines made it about 290px tall, so history-head's "press outside" moved to the Ours lane head.

Re-pointed with reasons: contract-page 5, history-timeline 2a, two-sides 4a, history-head (press outside), board-strip 2q, private-streams 7c, code-names 1/2b, every-door-lands-on-home (narrowed count), and f709, f714, f651, f442, f678, f740 5a, f741 3d, f742 1c/1d, f743 3d, f744 3c. Every new check is red at dfe908f and green now. The colour census moved (History, Details, one more amber tab badge on the wall) and was not re-recorded.
passes.ownerSummary: I built all the differences the checker listed for the Contracts wall, a contract's page and its History, after bringing in the latest main version first. Jambo now shows the same "Needs you" number on his tab everywhere. Beside a private contract he says who may open it, what details are still missing and that nobody has been named to sign, and his suggestions change with the contract. History now reads as drawn: each send is told once, the filters offer only what is actually there, today says "Today" and the wording is cut short around the change. The Details page now has Filing and People sections, shows the value "as amended" and in full, and lists related agreements with a "Bring it up" button. While checking, I found and fixed two small faults: scrolling the wall did not load more papers, and one missing detail was named by a table label ("effective") instead of plain words ("the start date"). Two things need your answer. Should Jambo's number match the bell, which counts a wider list? And should creating an amendment ask for one line on what it changes, so it can always be described? Nothing was pushed, and the colour census moved but was not re-recorded.
